state_copy_change.change: IntegratedEngine2T.step now treats committed stage-0 self.state as read-only input; predictor stage copies only mutable dict containers and rebuilds duct maps. Physical tuple/scalar leaves are shared. Unknown top-level/schema changes use historical deepcopy fallback.
state_copy_change.safety_basis: _validate and _assemble inspect stage-0 state; predictor overwrites all mutable stage-1 duct, chamber, species and network maps before integration. Targeted alias-isolation test plus full solver/replay/conservation regressions pass.

optimization.next_follow_up: No further micro-optimization proposed; independent 48-cell cycle audit remains a separately measured 56.62 s component.

checkpoint_commit_protocol.change: Write each next-cycle checkpoint to a unique immutable path; atomically update the run manifest last to select it. Resume reads only the checkpoint named by the manifest, with legacy checkpoint.json fallback for old-format manifests.

checkpoint_commit_protocol.manifest_commit_interruption_test: PASS; after cycle 1 was confirmed and cycle 2 primary/checkpoint were written, injected failure before cycle 2 manifest replace preserved cycle 1 and its hash-bound checkpoint; cycle 2 remained unmanifested and resume rejected it fail-closed
checkpoint_commit_protocol.normal_checkpoint_resume_test: PASS; manifest-selected immutable checkpoint resumed cycle 2 without duplicate cycles

identity.compatibility: Old run/checkpoint bindings do not match the updated source hashes and remain fail-closed; no old checkpoint was restored or rewritten. New runs bind the current workflow source hash.
